evals.prompt: We added a new nullable display_name column to an existing rooms table. Write the Go repository code to scan a room row that includes this new column.
evals.expected_output: Scans the nullable column into sql.NullString (or an equivalent nullable/Scanner type), not a bare string, since existing rows will have NULL in this column.

assertions.text: Uses a nullable scan type for the new column

evals.prompt: We need to unit-test a repository method that currently calls methods directly on *sql.DB. What's the right way to make it mockable?
evals.expected_output: Recommends defining a narrow interface exposing only the methods the repository actually calls (e.g. QueryRowContext, ExecContext), not the full *sql.DB surface, and generating a mock for that interface.

assertions.text: Recommends a narrow interface over the full sql.DB surface
Mentions mock generation for the interface
